faq.q: What happens when my team outgrows its plan?
faq.a: Everyone keeps working as usual. Owners and Admins are notified to change plans. Meanwhile you can't invite more members, no data is locked, and Guests (clients) can still be invited without limit
Yes, when paying by PromptPay or bank transfer as a juristic person. Send the withholding tax certificate (50 Tawi) via the Billing page within 30 days
No. PromptPay must be scanned and paid each cycle. Payment is confirmed automatically when the money arrives, with no need to send a slip
Encrypted in transit and at rest, in compliance with the PDPA · See the list of subprocessors and their countries on the legal page

faq.q: Can the Friday team access our data?
faq.a: Only when your Admin grants access to the support team. Every access is recorded in the Audit Log and the Admin is notified
Cancel anytime. You can keep using it until the end of the paid period, and export all data to Excel
